summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K on 1 October 2026 disclosing total voting rights under the UK Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1R. As of 30 September 2026, issued share capital comprised 4,316,311,549 ordinary shares of 31 pence each, of which 270,881,064 were held in treasury, leaving total voting rights of 4,045,430,485. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary transparency notification equivalent to a US share-count disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
